name: @typeset/engine
description: Deterministic document typesetting engine with strict resume and cover-letter codecs shared by every Typeset consumer.

scripts.eval: npm run eval:inline-marks && npm run eval:resume-file && npm run eval:cover-letter-file && npm run eval:download && npm run eval:layout && npm run eval:pdf-font-parity && npm run eval:pdf-export-scheduling && npm run eval:pdf-links
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run eval && npm run fonts:check
scripts.fonts:check: node scripts/run-python.mjs scripts/generate_font_assets.py --check && node scripts/run-python.mjs scripts/generate_pdf_fonts.py --check
